# Code Anchors: Grep-Native Retrieval

- `libs/portable-tools/src/drift-advisory.ts` — confines community detection to offline, advisory-only proposals, never persisted as page metadata or read as an index, so retrieval stays grep-native.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/generate-atlas.ts` — builds the one derived orientation surface that no tool retrieves through.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.ts` — bounds the neighbour list per entry instead of against the page cap, and holds a page's asserted content byte-identical where a change may only append, so what a reader loads without reaching the log cannot silently move.
- `libs/origin/v2/.nexus/decisions/0003-concept-schema.md` — the neighbour-list and retrieval-cap contract.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/reading-list.ts` — applies the model to planning: matched pages first, then their neighbours, seven in all (#903)
